verdict.rationale: FreshBooks Bill Pay documents capturing vendor bills by forwarding them or by uploading or photographing them, with automatic data extraction. It also documents scheduling ACH or check payments and tracking each payment through to paid. Nothing in the evidence covers routing bills for approval, a core part of this story, and the evidence is vendor claims only. Missing for 10: bill approval routing or workflows, independent or hands-on corroboration of the capture-to-payment flow.

support.subject: As an accountant, I can capture vendor bills, route them for approval, and schedule payments from one workflow

citations.quote: Upload a file or snap a photo; Bill Pay reads the details and recreates the bill in FreshBooks
Forward your bills to your FreshBooks account, schedule vendor payments, and watch each payment move from created to paid.
FreshBooks Bill Pay* makes it easy for small businesses to manage bills, schedule payments, and pay any vendor by ACH or check.
